test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six students P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U. P is sitting third to the right of U. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S. S is sitting second to the right of P. Who is the immediate neigbour of both R and S?
solution:
Given: Six students P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) P is sitting third to the right of U.

2) S is sitting second to the right of P.

3) Q is sitting to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5875bbc8a70d4b8fe249844136859a9bc29da3fedc9992193e8a81b6a22110c.png] 

4) R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a46c686e5e8f1413f1042cd9d781ff39d6237ed44429625b826029e4d969e93.png] 

So, 'U' is the immediate neigbour of both R and S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
